༄༅/ /gnyen po lha gsum gyi dbang dang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sogs kyi kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dngos grub dga' ston bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gnyen po lha gsum gyi dbang dang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sogs kyi kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dngos grub dga' ston bzhugs so//

dpal rta mgrin lha gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir gnyen po lha gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub dbang las sbyor sogs kyi tshe/ kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba ni/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha chang zan la sogs pa'i bza' btung g.yos sbyar gyi longs spyod sna tshogs pa zhing lpags sam/ gcan gzan pags pa'i steng du bsham/ me rlung chus sbyangs shing*/ hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ/ bdag nyid dbang chen phyag rdor thugs srog las// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ las me rlung chu spros pas// tshogs kyi 'bag btsog dri ma dngos 'dzin chus| |bsregs gtor bkrus pas dag cing gtsang bar gyur// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ zhes sbyangs/ sman mchod bran la/ hūm̐ */ rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu la gnas pa'i| |bhandha yangs par rdzas rnams sha lnga dang*// bdud rtsi rnam lngar rang rang sa bon mtshan// yaṃ las rlung g.yos raṃ las me sbar bas// thod pa dros shing rdzas khol nyes skyon rnams// lbu ba'i rnam par phyir lud nyes skyon ni// dkar dmar mdangs ldan dam tshig bdud rtsi'i steng*// hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ gsum mthing dmar dkar brtsegs las// 'od 'phros rtsa gsum zhi khro'i byin rlabs rnams// ye shes bdud rtsir bkug nas rdzas la bstim// yig gsum 'od zhu rdzas dang 'dres pa yis// zag med tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur// ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ tshogs rdzas nas cha gsum spros pa'i dang po mchod pa ni/ gtor mar sman raka bsgron la/ hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ/ chos dbyings rab 'byams zhing khams nas// dbang chen 'bar ba khro bo'i rgyal// gsang bdag lag na rdo rje 'chang*// mkha' lding 'dab chags rgyal po che// rigs bzhi klu yi 'khor dang bcas// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// phyi nang gsang mchod 'dod yon lnga// zag med tshogs kyi mchod par bcas// 'bul gyi bzhes la sgrub pa por// thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ ha ya grī ba badzra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/

puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapad/ rū pa/ shapad/ gandhe/ ra sa/ sparshe/ a mṛ ta/ ma hā rakta/ ba lingta/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza pra tītstsha hoḥ zhes mchod/ bar pa bsgron la bskang zhing bshags pa ni/ hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ/ gnyen po lha gsum klu yi 'khor dang bcas// sngags 'chang bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'dis// dbang chen gsang bdag bya khyung klu 'khor bcas// dgyes pa bskyed phyir thugs dam gnyan po bskang*// skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub bdag la stsol// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul ba'i las dbang gis// bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod las sbyor dam rdzas sogs// chad lhag nor 'khrul brjid nyams 'gal la sogs// nongs gyur gang mchis gnong 'gyod sems kyis bshags// tshangs par mdzod la bzod pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ ha ya grī ba badzra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa nā ga rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sogs yi ge brgya pa bzla/ tha ma bsgral bstab ni/ zan ling sha khrag gis sbags pa dmigs bya yod na de'i dri mas bsnos pa/ bhandha 'am/ lcags snod du bzhag par rakta bran/ dgug gzhug gsum sogs byas nas/ hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ/ dbang chen 'bar ba gsang ba'i bdag /khyung chen klu yi 'khor bcas rnams// drag po'i las la thugs dam bskul// sprul pa'i pho nya rab 'bar ba// 'gugs 'ching sdom myos tshogs spros pas// dgra bgegs bla srog rnam shes bcas// myur du khug cig gzugs la bstim// skyob par byed pa'i lha dang phrol// gsod byed bshan pa'i lag tu sprod// oṃ ha ya grī ba badzra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a mu kaṃ sha trūṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ badzra ghaṇṭe hoḥ a nṛ shag phye ya/ zhes 'gugs dbye phur thun mtshon chas rdeg cing*/ hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ/ gnyen po lha gsum klu 'khor bcas// khros pa'i pho nya bshan pa'i tshogs// skar ltar 'khrugs shing glog ltar 'khyug

/thun ni nad mtshon thog ser char// phab pas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /rdo rje phur bu rab sgril zhing*// snying la btab pas lus sems phral// rnam shes dbang chen thugs kar bstim// phung khams skye mched thal bar rlog /drag po mtshon cha'i rno dbal gyis// sha rus pags pa dum bur bsgral// dgra bgegs nyon mongs rtsad nas chod// oṃ ha ya grī ba badzra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa nā ga rā dza a mu kaṃ sha trūṃ nṛ tri trig nan rbad nan bhi na tsitta rbad nan hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad sod thun bhyo/ zhes bsgral gtor mar bstabs la tshogs rdzas dang sman raka bsgron la/ hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ/ dbang chen 'bar ba zhal gdongs shig /gsang bdag dregs pa zhal gdongs shig /mkha' lding rgyal po zhal gdongs shig /'khor gyi klu rnams zhal gdongs shig /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// rkang klad nang khrol khu ba zhag /phung po khams dang skye mched bcas| |zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li// dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya// bzhes shig lhag ma med par mdzod// rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs// tshe dpal rnal 'byor bdag la bstim// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'grub par mdzod// oṃ ha ya grī ba badzra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a mu kaṃ sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rakta la khā hi/ ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi/ ma hā tsitta la khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta la khā hi/ ma hā skandha la khā hi/ ma hā dhā tu la khā hi/ ma hā srog ādzñā la khā hi/ ma hā a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ma hā rakta la khā hi/ ma hā ba lingta la khā hi/ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ ma hā sarba pū dzaḥ zhes bstab/ tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus sman raka bran/ gtso bos chang gi kha phru 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i dbus nas btab la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/

hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ ha ya grī ba badzra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra utstshiṣṭa pa ti sarba dza dzaḥhriṃ hrīṃ ā gatstsha yā mi/ zhes lhag mar dbang ba rnams bkug la/ hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ/ phud dang tshogs dang lhag ma'i bdag /lha dang sngags 'chang pho nya gsum// kun rdzob ltar snang tha dad kyang*// chos nyid don la dbyings su gcig /gnyen po lha gsum klu yi 'khor// bcas pa'i bka' nyan lhag sdud tshogs// ma sring mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang*// sha za sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs dpal chen pha 'bab ni// tshogs kyi lhag ma sman raka dang*// 'dod yon bcas pa 'di 'bul gyi// longs shig khyer cig bzung bar mdzod// zo zhig 'thung zhig tshim par mdzod// dpal gyi bka' lung dam bsgrags bzhin// sngags 'chang bdag gi bar chad sol// mthun rkyen tshe bsod longs spyod spel// gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs/ /bcol ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod// oṃ ha ya grī ba badzra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra utstshiṣṭa pati gṛhṇa bhuñdza tha pi ba tha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes sgrub pa yin na gtor ma'i zhol dkyil 'khor 'gram du 'bul/ skabs gzhan du na gtsang sar 'bul lo// zhes pa 'di'ang gzhung gi dbang chog gi mjug tu dga' ba bsgom zhing tshogs la spyad/ ces tshogs kyi dga' ston bya bar gsungs nas/ de'i cho ga ma gsungs pas de dag kha skong ba'i slad du/ gzhan yang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sogs kyi skabs kyang nye bar mkho ba'i phyir 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pas/ lcags stag zla ba bcu pa'i nyer gnyis la/ sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
